headline: Dominated the ball,
dropped the points.
claim.lead: United took 3.00 points per game in the ten matches they held under 45% of the ball, and 1.40 in the fifteen they held over 55% — while creating their best chances in the second group. Split on ws_possession_pct.

kpis.note: xG 1.90 for, 1.30 against, per match · Twelve

fails.t: No evidence the response to going behind improved
fails.b: 1.18 goals per 90 while trailing in GW1–19 against 2.40 in GW20–38 looks like a story, but it is 6 goals against 7. Intervals [0.47, 2.60] and [1.46, 5.48] overlap almost completely.

fails.t: Home-versus-away finishing when behind is suggestive only
fails.b: Trailing at home: 3 goals from 77 shots, 3.9%. Trailing away: 10 from 71, 14.1%. The intervals barely separate and it rests on 3 goals at home. A question, not a finding.

method: WhoScored files an own goal under the player who scored it, so reading team naively credits the wrong side. Because every metric here is conditioned on game state, one mis-attributed goal inverts the state for every event after that minute. Nothing runs unless the reconstructed scoreline agrees with the master on all 38 matches.
Goals are attributed to the state that existed before they were scored, otherwise every equaliser would file as scored while level.
Chance quality is a shot-angle proxy scaled so each match sums to Twelve’s published expected goals. The totals come from the source; the split across states is what this adds.
Possession here is share of on-ball actions, not time, so it will not match ws_possession_pct exactly.

turning_points.title: Amorim dismissed after MW20
turning_points.body: Sacked on 5 January 2026, the day after a 1–1 at Leeds, on 1.55 points per game. Darren Fletcher took MW21 at Burnley; Michael Carrick was appointed on the 13th.

turning_points.title: Carrick starts with the derby
turning_points.body: First match in charge: City beaten 2–0 at Old Trafford, then Arsenal 3–2 away a week later — six points from the two sides that finished first and second.

turning_points.title: 3–2 at the Emirates
turning_points.body: Behind after 28 minutes, level by 36, ahead by 52, pegged back at 86 and won it at 89. The game-state walk for this match is on the 25/26 season page.

turning_points.title: The dominance trap
turning_points.body: Ten matches under 45% possession: ten wins, 3.00 points per game on an xG difference of +0.10. Fifteen matches over 55%: 1.40 per game on +1.07. The season's best chances came in its worst results.
turning_points.source: 25/26 season payload, buckets split on ws_possession_pct
